messages:
Lia: Quick sync — postmortem items from INC-2024-09. Pasted the short action list below; please reply with `take / pass / nominate @name` + due date and any blockers. I will update the doc: https://go.redwood/inc-2024-09

Lia: ```
1) Reduce retry storm by adding client-side backoff and bounded retries — suggested owner: TBD — suggested due: 2024-05-02
2) Add circuit-breaker to routing layer + metric + alert — suggested owner: TBD — suggested due: 2024-05-09
3) Stabilize cache eviction tests + add eviction telemetry — suggested owner: TBD — suggested due: 2024-05-05
4) Post-release verification runbook and signoff checklist — suggested owner: TBD — suggested due: 2024-05-15
```

Ravi (eng-runtime): I can take item 1. Due 2024-05-02 works for me. Need a quick infra toggle to test rollback behavior — @Nora can you help with a temp flag? :thumbsup:

Nora (eng-infra): @Ravi yep I can add a runtime flag in the staging config. Will schedule the change for 2024-04-30 and hand you the toggle URL. For item 3 I can help with infra-side logs but not owning the tests.

Sam (eng-platform): I'll pick up item 2 (circuit-breaker). Put me down as owner, due 2024-05-09. FYI we already have a proto CB in prod branch; PR incoming tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Canary note — deploy 2024-04-30 03:12 UTC introduced an intermittent 429 spike, rolled back at 03:45. See /deploys/2024-04-30-321 for trace.

Data Team (data-platform): Can someone paste the failing query or span ID? we want to verify whether telemetry needs schema changes before eviction metrics land.

Lia: Spans below (sample): `span_id=af3b2c`, failing query path: `svc/ingest/serialize` — logs in the incident doc. @Data Team lemme know if you want a dump.

Olivia (sre): I'll own item 4 (post-release verification & signoff). Plan: smoke tests + synthetic traffic for 48h, then run checklist. Proposed due 2024-05-15. I'll coordinate with Sam and Ravi for CB + backoff verification.

Ravi (eng-runtime): noted @Olivia. After infra flag is up I'll run a canary harness against the toggle and share results by 2024-05-01.

Nora (eng-infra): For item 3 — I can take the telemetry hook (eviction metric) with a target 2024-05-06, but the flaky tests ownership should be with QA. @Maya-qa can you confirm?

Lia: Good point. @Maya-qa please confirm test ownership. If QA takes tests, Nora will ship telemetry by 2024-05-06.

Maya-qa: I can own the test stabilization. Moving due to 2024-05-12 (need a few runs to de-flake). Will collaborate with Nora on telemetry.

Sam (eng-platform): PR for circuit-breaker opened: https://git.redwood/r/platform/pulls/842 — requesting review from @alice and @ravi. ETA for merge 2024-05-02, rollout policy will be gradual.

Lia: Perfect — summary I'll update in the doc: 1 -> Ravi (2024-05-02), 2 -> Sam (2024-05-09), 3 -> Maya-qa (tests 2024-05-12) + Nora (telemetry 2024-05-06), 4 -> Olivia (2024-05-15). If anyone needs to change dates, reply here. Thanks all. :heart:

Olivia (sre): ACK — I'll kick off verification once Sam/Ravi confirm rollout windows.

Ravi (eng-runtime): ACK — adding the ticket for item 1 now and will link tests.

Sam (eng-platform): :thumbsup: will post rollout schedule in the PR and p90 latency checklists.

Lia: Closing the loop here — I updated the postmortem doc and created a tracking spreadsheet. I'll DM owners for any conflicts. If nothing else, consider this thread the assignment confirmation.

Data Team (data-platform): Thanks — we'll look at span `af3b2c` and verify ingest side telemetry; will comment on the doc by EOD.

Lia: Great, thanks team. I'll re-open if a handoff changes.
